title: Virginia Small Estate Affidavit (2026): $75,000 Limit, 60-Day Wait, All Heirs Sign
rank_math_description: Virginia's small estate affidavit now covers $75,000 (July 2025). 60-day wait, every heir signs, no court filing, and a no-affidavit rule up to $35,000.
pdf_outline: Worksheet: personal probate assets at date of death; flag any single asset <= $35,000
Successor list with signature lines and designated successor
Second PDF va-small-estate-checklist.pdf: 7 steps incl. probating the will with the circuit court clerk
